visual.general_description: Black-and-white boxed PRISMA flow diagram with four vertical stage labels (Identification, Screening, Eligibility, Included) and boxes joined by blue arrows.

Screening band: a left box "Titles/abstracts screened (n = 16)" and a right box "Records excluded, clearly unrelated/off-topic, e.g. dermatology, animal models, granulomatous diseases (n = 8)", joined by a blue arrow. Eligibility band: a left box "Full-text articles assessed for eligibility (n = 8)" and a right box "Full-text articles excluded, with reasons: transplant-related tularemia (n = 1)", joined by a blue arrow. Included band: a single left box "Studies included in qualitative synthesis (n = 7)". The diagram has no patient images, plotted data or axes.

visual.general_description: Grayscale frontal chest radiograph with two black arrows, eight small white arrowheads in four pairs, a small gray "R" marker box and the printed word "Liegend".
visual.detailed_description: A grayscale chest radiograph shows both lungs, the mediastinum, the clavicles and the upper abdomen with the diaphragm domes at the bottom. A small gray square at the top left of the image holds the letter "R", and the word "Liegend" is printed in white text to its right. Two long black arrows are drawn on the lung fields: one on the image-left lung field pointing down and toward the mediastinum, and one on the image-right lung field pointing leftward toward the mediastinum. Eight small white triangular arrowheads are arranged in four rows of two, forming two short vertical columns facing each other over the lower part of the image-right lung field beside the cardiac silhouette. The lung fields show faint, patchy, slightly reduced transparency near the arrows. No chart, table or axis is present.

visual.general_description: Two-panel grayscale chest CT figure: axial lung-window slice (a) and coronal slice (b), with black arrows, white arrowheads and, in b, two white ovals.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a: Axial CT slice through the lower chest at lung window with the heart in the centre, the spine at the bottom and ribs around the edge. The letter "a" is printed in white at the lower left. Two black arrows point at patchy hazy opacities in the periphery of the lungs, one at each side of the image. Seven small white arrowheads are scattered over the image-left posterior lung. Patchy hazy and denser areas are visible beside otherwise dark lung. Panel b: Coronal CT slice of the chest with the trachea at the top centre and the diaphragm and upper abdomen at the bottom. The letter "b" is printed in white at the lower left. Two black arrows point at hazy patchy opacities at the lower outer part of each lung. Two white oval outlines enclose areas in the upper lung fields, one in each lung, containing tiny dots. One small white arrowhead lies near the bottom centre below the lung bases.
